metadata.label: scammer_confirm_wallet
metadata.description: Phishing drainer posing as 'confirm-wallet.ton'. Drain contract immediately forwards received TON to the collector wallet confirm-wallet.ton, which launders funds to Gate.io hot wallet with memo 4825351565. Victim wallet UQBuC6OFKRqv68hJ9HuJOLzAkqWojXZ_XpzWgt9BrpcZY9CF signed external v5r1 messages that sent TON into the drainer.

addresses.comment: Drainer contract. Forwards received TON to the collector confirm-wallet.ton.
Collector wallet confirm-wallet.ton. Forwarded 2220+ TON to Gate.io hot wallet.
